title: Counts view
description: The counts people see, as one manager works them out (docs/protocol/counts.md, #15512; step 6 of docs/plans/plan-derived-counts.md): one view per manager, relayed by the hub as it is, added up by each client over the managers in a surface's scope. One named field per count id and no surfaces map: each client names the ids it draws. Samples in spec/fixtures/counts/view_samples.json.

CountsView.description: One manager's counts. A view with a new epoch replaces the one kept; within an epoch a lower rev loses to a higher one.

rev.description: Goes up with every view the manager makes in this epoch.

as_of.description: When the manager made the view, in Unix milliseconds: only to say how old a kept view is.

build.description: The manager build that made the view (its version), so a number can be read against the definition that build applies (docs/protocol/counts.md, "Changing a count").

CountsEpoch.description: One run of the manager: a restart starts a new epoch, and its rev starts again. Opaque: only compared.

CountsViewCounts.description: Each count the manager works out, by its id. A count the manager does not work out (a build from before the id) is absent, never 0.

agents_needs_you.description: The Agents that need the owner (docs/protocol/counts.md, "agents_needs_you").

todos_needs_you.description: The to-dos that need the owner, N of the To-dos list (docs/protocol/counts.md, "todos_needs_you").

persona_cards.description: Pending owner cards on Persona conversations and quiet tasks' agents, one per card (docs/protocol/counts.md, "persona_cards").

CountsViewTotals.description: Each count's n again, by its id, for what reads a number without its rows: the hub copies it as it is into pushes and widget wakes, and never decodes counts.

CountsViewCount.description: One count: its number, the rows it counts and the rows the list keeps but the count leaves out.

n.description: The number drawn: the counted rows, as many as keys lists plus more.

keys.description: The counted rows, oldest first, at most 200; absent when none.

held.description: Rows the list keeps but the count leaves out, oldest first, at most 200; absent when none.

more.description: The counted rows keys leaves out: n less the rows keys lists. Absent when keys lists them all.

cards.description: The row's pending cards, oldest first: a card row lists that one card. Absent for a session that waits in its terminal with no card.

CountsHeldRow.description: One row the count leaves out, and why.

CountsRowKey.description: A row as the shared fixtures key it: agent:<machine>/<session> for a session (its children's and sides' cards under it), card:<interaction id> for a card counted on its own.

CountsCardID.description: A pending card's interaction id, as POST /api/v1/interactions/{id}/resolve takes it.

CountsHeldReason.description: Why a row is listed but not counted: muted, the owner muted the agent or its space; held, its only cards are questions the assistant is still deciding whether it may answer (D11 of docs/plans/plan-derived-counts.md). A word a client does not know reads as its Unknown, and the row stays uncounted.
